About GIRNAR AYURVEDIC PHARMACY PVT. LTD.

We at Girnar Ayurvedic Pharmacy Pvt. Ltd., have been assessing the high market demands for various personal care products and completing them with our unique selection. Since the year 1996, we have been making development in the personal care industry by providing the most effective products as a manufacturer and supplier. Girnar Strawberry Lip Care Balm, Vitamin C Foaming Face Wash, Aloe Vera Moisturizing Cream, London Yard Fragrance Perfume, Herbal Sandal Wood Soap Bars, Herbal Onion Hair Oil, and many more products are included in our extensive collection. We make sure to do many quality checks after the products are properly produced, and only then do we provide our approval for them to be packaged and dispatched. Additionally, prices of our products is also kept reasonable.
